title: AAPL Stock: 3 Important Items for Apple Q2 Earnings Call
text: AAPL Stock: 3 Important Items for Apple Q2 Earnings Call A Storm Brewing for AAPL StockApple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) will hold the Apple Q2 earnings call after the closing bell on Tuesday, but most of you knew that. Every investor marks the Apple earnings report date on their calendar, even those who don't own AAPL stock.This is in part because Apple has become a bellwether for the consumer electronics market. As goes Apple, so goes the rest of the market.So, it's a good sign that analysts expect $2.69 earnings per share (EPS) on $61.33 billion in revenue. Those are positive numbers for Apple.
